subject: a blank pocket watch holding a folded ocean sheet
pose: open case tilted toward the viewer
art_direction: 无刻度怀表内部是一张折叠海面，青蓝波片夹在珊瑚外壳中，表环形成上扬姿态。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create an open pocket watch with a coral enamel case and no clock hands, numbers, or lettering. Its interior holds one folded sheet of ocean water, forming three sharp pleats that retain translucent turquoise depth and a few white wave edges. The upper watch ring leans backward like a small crest, giving the compact object a poised personality. Keep the water contained inside the case; nothing splashes outward. Render brushed metal along the hinge and controlled reflections within the folded water. Use a warm sand background with a single soft shadow. Frame the open watch centrally at three-quarter angle, large enough for the impossible material fold to read in a circular avatar.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
